Thank you for nominating BLACK PANTHER for seven Academy Awards®, including Best Picture. If you haven't had a chance to see the film on the big screen, we hope you do so when it returns to AMC Theatres for free, beginning February 1 - 7.

Showtimes are 4pm and 7pm.

To book tickets, email DisneyAwardsOffice@disney.com or call 855-560-6212.
